== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|An Incarnation is a being that has become the physical embodiment of its specific [[Territory]]'s essence and power. This transformation occurs when a [[Traveler]] draws an excessive amount of energy from their [[Territory]] into themselves, upsetting the natural balance. Once this process is complete, the individual ceases to be human and instead becomes a force of nature similar to gravity or heat. [[Incarnations]] possess immense, nearly limitless power and access to the abilities of their respective Houses. However, they are inherently tied to their home worlds; if they remain in a foreign realm for too long, the environment begins to warp and reshape itself to mirror their [[Territory]]. This phenomenon can lead to an Incarnation becoming trapped within its own world as it is absorbed into the fabric of that reality. While they are described as noble creatures, being in a foreign world can drive them to madness, making them behave like unpredictable and dangerous beasts. During the initial stages of their transformation, they are particularly volatile, driven by an overwhelming compulsion to act according to the nature of their [[Territory]]. Historically, certain realms have used [[blood]] sacrifices to maintain seals that keep these powerful entities contained and prevent them from causing widespread [[destruction]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|An Incarnation is a fundamental force, similar to gravity or heat, that serves as an embodiment of its [[Territory]]'s nature and power. This phenomenon occurs when a [[Traveler]] loses control of their abilities due to being covered by black chain-marks, resulting in an entity that can warp reality into a [[Territory]] and summon monster armies from it. Within the corridors of a house, an Incarnation that is part of [[Valinhall]] and represents the world itself attacked the [[Damascans]]. During a battle with [[Simon]], this entity wielded a flame-headed hammer while [[Alin]] doubted his ability to assist against such immense power. To reach the Incarnation, [[Simon]] had to allow the [[chains]] to wrap fully around his neck, as he required a [[The mask|mask]] to defeat the force.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|An Incarnation is a creature formed when [[Travelers]] draw excessive power from their [[Territory]], a transformation viewed as a death sentence. These beings, such as [[Alin]], are characterized by dark [[chains]] upon their skin and eyes where darkness bleeds into the whites. While they can be killed or sealed, an Incarnation does not return upon death but instead leaves the way open for a successor. Such entities are exceptions to many rules, often possessing clockwork components beneath their armor, and have been known to wreck Houses or summon [[Golems|golems]] to battle others. [[Zakareth]] recognized the potential benefits of this state, even as [[Indirial]] was reportedly seen fighting one before his disappearance.}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Do not let the chains cover your body,” he said. “What? Why?” Simon asked, shaken. The chains were already up past his elbows; how much longer did he have? “What will happen if they do?” “Incarnation,” Kai responded.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c13" />}}

* {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|“Without the mask, I can’t defeat the Incarnation.”<ref name="tg-02-crimson-vault-c20" />}}
